title: Implement IPFS pin API wrapper with retry and health check
description:
Implement PinClient with methods: pin(cid: Cid) -> Result<()>, unpin(cid: Cid) -> Result<()>, is_pinned(cid: Cid) -> bool, list_pinned() -> Vec<Cid>. Retry logic: 3 attempts with exponential backoff. Health check: ping IPFS node on startup; fail fast if unreachable. Artifact: transit/src/retention/pin_client.rs.

Acceptance:
- pin() is idempotent (pinning already-pinned CID is not an error)
- unpin() on an unpinned CID returns Ok(()) (not an error)
- is_pinned() returns correct value in all cases
- list_pinned() returns all pinned CIDs (tested with known corpus)
- Health check on startup prints warning if IPFS node unreachable (does not abort transit)
